subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum has always been a bit of a mystery to other folks—an orc cleric of a dragon god.
source_quote: He has always been a bit of a mystery to other folks—an orc cleric of a dragon god.

subject: Grygum's belief in Bahamut
fact: Grygum's belief in whether Bahamut moved Stroud’s hand or if Stroud acted with agency is not specified in this session.
source_quote: But others believed that Bahamut moved Stroud’s hand and hid the move from Protanther.

subject: Grygum's view on dragon goodness
fact: Grygum's view on whether the scale color of a dragon defines the intrinsic goodness of a creature that lives for a millenia is not specified in this session.
source_quote: he didn’t want to get into another argument about free will, the will of the gods, and whether the scale color of a dragon defined the intrinsic goodness of a creature that lived for a millenia.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realizes he can use Shape Water to move the boat off the sandbar.
source_quote: And then a flash of inspiration hits him, “Stop, I can do this.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz casts Shape Water and successfully pushes the boat over the sandbar.
source_quote: He casts the spell and uses it to push a small wave over the sandbar. The extra water is enough to move the boat forward. He keeps doing it, and pretty soon, the ship rises over the sand and is free.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz turns to the group and says, “So?” after succeeding with Shape Water.
source_quote: he turns to the group and says, “So?”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is aware of the group’s doubt but is confident in his ability this time.
source_quote: Daz is aware of their doubt, but this time, he is confident.

subject: Daz's memory of the apprentice saying
fact: Daz remembers the saying “Overpromise and under-deliver!” but questions whether his memory is accurate.
source_quote: He remembers an old saying from his days as an apprentice, “Overpromise and under-deliver!” But the last few days have made him question his memory.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith laughs, “It would have been useful a while ago…”
source_quote: Sarith laughs, “It would have been useful a while ago…”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz watches as Grygum and Thorin prepare to get into the water to push.
source_quote: Daz watches as Grygum and Thorin prepare to get into the water to push.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz enjoys a brief moment of applause and congratulations.
